role: validation-only immutable transport for the already accepted exact Seller Swagger bytes; never production input

carrier.part_encoding: ASCII base64 fragments without line endings; concatenate in listed order
carrier.encoding: concatenated base64 with one canonical trailing LF
carrier.checkout_portability: Each part contains no line endings. Materializer concatenates exact part bytes and appends one LF before carrier identity. Decoded XZ and raw Swagger remain strict byte identities.

authority.note: This carrier does not redefine Seller Swagger authority. It transports the already verified accepted exact bytes after live docs recovery became non-deterministic on GitHub runners.
